from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Gradient Descent: Refining the Model", [
            "Gradient descent refines the model's weights.",
            "Think of a hiker descending in fog.",
            "Small steps avoid overshooting the lowest point."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display a 3D bowl shape surface in #8A2BE2.
        axes = ThreeDAxes(x_range=[-3, 3], y_range=[-3, 3], z_range=[-1, 3], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        surface = Surface(
            lambda u, v: np.array([u, v, 0.1*(u**2 + v**2)]),
            u_range=[-2.5, 2.5], v_range=[-2.5, 2.5],
            resolution=(30, 30)
        ).set_fill(color="#8A2BE2", opacity=0.8).set_stroke(color=WHITE, opacity=0.2, width=0.5)
        
        bowl = VGroup(axes, surface)
        self.place_in_area(bowl, 'A2', 'E5', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(bowl))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#8A2BE2")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Show a ball rolling down to the minimum.
        ball = Dot(color="#FF4500", radius=0.15)
        ball.move_to(axes.c2p(2, 2, 0.8)) # start position
        self.add(ball)
        
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(ball, surface), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF4500")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Mark the minimum point with #FFD700 flashing star.
        star = Star(color="#FFD700", fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0)
        self.place_at_grid(star, 'D4', scale_factor=0.4)
        star.move_to(axes.c2p(0, 0, 0)) # aligns with bowl center
        
        self.play(Flash(star, color="#FFD700", flash_radius=0.3, num_lines=12, line_stroke_width=3, line_length=0.2))
        self.play(FadeIn(star))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFD700")
        self.wait(2)
